parsed.explanation: The strongest visitor-facing risks are national entry screening that can refuse cases over sex-document discrepancies, and passport/visa rules that create substantial document friction for trans travelers. The dossier does not establish that lifetime fraud findings are automatic or commonly imposed, so that severe possibility is not treated as routine. Facility restrictions apply in many, but not all, state/provinces; one documented arrest and detention show the consequences can include handcuffing and placement in a men’s ward. National custody harms are serious but rely here on uncorroborated reporting. Protections and legal challenges are real but do not remove operative restrictions, and the political climate is openly hostile. No trans-specific violence rate is documented, so violence cannot be assessed as a pattern.
